title: Dhanya Teras!
description: It was the day when Mahavir sat in one place, to shed all his life cycles of birth and death. The last 24 tirthankara, Lord Mahavir, of our current hundavsarpini period, adopted his seat, being nivritti – after having conquered his passions (kashaya), to be absorbed into shukla dhyan, in the last two samays of 14th gunasthan, to conquer his last last remaining 85 Karma prakritiyon. Thus the day was dhanya or blessed/auspicious.

title: Chaudas Parva (चतुर्दशी पर्व तिथि)
hindi_title: आश्विन शुक्ल चौदस — पवित्र पर्वराज तिथि
description: Every Chaturdashi (चौदस) of both Shukla and Krishna paksha is revered as a supreme Parva Tithi in Digambar Jainism. It is a day dedicated to soul-introspection, fasting, and self-restraint. Ascetics and householders abstain from green vegetables (Hari tyag), observe complete celibacy (Brahmacharya), and spend time in Jinendra swadhyaya.

title: Sharad Purnima (शरद पूर्णिमा / कोजागरी पर्व)
hindi_title: आश्विन पूर्णिमा — आध्यात्मिक शांति एवं ध्यान पर्व
description: Sharad Purnima marks the night of complete cosmic calm and the brightest moon of the year. In the Jain tradition, this auspicious night is dedicated to serene Dhyan (meditation) and contemplation on the pure, untainted nature of the soul, which shines just like the spotless full moon.

title: Diwali Parv — Bhagwan Mahavir Nirvana Mahotsav (दीपावली पर्व)
hindi_title: दीपावली — भगवान महावीर निर्वाण कल्याणक एवं गौतम स्वामी केवलज्ञान
description: On this sacred dawn at Pawapuri, the 24th Tirthankar Bhagwan Mahavir attained Moksha (Nirvana) in the early morning of Kartik Krishna Amavasya. Celestial beings illuminated pure ghee lamps (Deepavali) to preserve the spiritual brilliance of Jinendra's teachings. Devotees offer the sacred Nirvana Ladoo in temples.

title: Jain New Year & Gautam Gandharva Kevalgyan (वीर निर्वाण संवत्)
hindi_title: वीर निर्वाण संवत् नववर्ष एवं गौतम स्वामी केवलज्ञान दिवस
description: Following Bhagwan Mahavir's Nirvana, his foremost disciple Gautama Swami attained supreme Kevalgyan (omniscience). Jains celebrate this dawn as the beginning of the auspicious Veer Nirvana Samvat New Year (वीर निर्वाण संवत् २५५३).

title: Gyan Panchami (ज्ञान पंचमी / सौभाग्य पंचमी)
hindi_title: ज्ञान पंचमी — आगम शास्त्र एवं जिनवाणी पूजन दिवस
description: Gyan Panchami is dedicated exclusively to the worship of knowledge (Samyag Gyan) and the sacred scriptures (Jinavani / Agamas). Devotees dust, clean, and venerate ancient sacred manuscripts and shastras in temple libraries.

title: Kartik Purnima & Ashtahnika Mahaparv (कार्तिक पूर्णिमा)
hindi_title: कार्तिक पूर्णिमा — चातुर्मास निष्ठापन एवं अष्टाह्निका समापन
description: Kartik Purnima marks the completion of the 4-month monsoon retreat (Chaturmas) for Digambar Jain Munis and Aryikas. It also marks the culmination of the 8-day sacred Ashtahnika Mahaparv, celebrating the eternal Siddhayatanas of Nandishwar Dweep.

title: Paryushan Mahaparv — Das Lakshan Parv (दशलक्षण महापर्व)
hindi_title: दशलक्षण महापर्व (उत्तम क्षमा से उत्तम ब्रह्मचर्य)
tithi_date: Bhadrapada Shukla Panchami to Chaturdashi (भाद्रपद शुक्ल पंचमी से चतुर्दशी)
description: The king of all spiritual festivals in Jainism. Observed over 10 sacred days, dedicated to the contemplation and practice of the Ten Virtues of Supreme Dharma: Uttam Kshama (Forgiveness) to Uttam Brahmacharya (Celibacy/Self-absorption).

title: Kshamavani Parv — Universal Forgiveness Day (क्षमावाणी महापर्व)
hindi_title: क्षमावाणी महापर्व — 'मिच्छामि दुक्कडं' एवं 'खम्मावेमि सव्वे जीवे'
description: The concluding day of Das Lakshan Parv where every Jain asks for and grants forgiveness to all living beings in the cosmos for any harm caused knowingly or unknowingly through mind, speech, or action.

title: Bhagwan Mahavir Janma Kalyanak (महावीर जयंती)
description: Celebration of the birth of the 24th Tirthankar Vardhaman Mahavir at Kundagram. Born to King Siddhartha and Queen Trishala, Bhagwan Mahavir revived the ancient Shraman tradition, emphasizing Ahimsa Paramo Dharma, Anekantavada, and Aparigraha.

title: Akshaya Tritiya — Bhagwan Rishabhdev Parna Parv (अक्षय तृतीया)
hindi_title: अक्षय तृतीया — प्रथम तीर्थंकर आदिनाथ भगवान प्रथम आहार दिवस
description: Commemorates the first Ahar (pure alms) offered to the first Tirthankar Bhagwan Rishabhdev (Adinath) by King Shreyansha after a 13-month Nirjala Upvas. King Shreyansha offered pure sugarcane juice (Iksu Rasa), laying the eternal foundation of Dana Dharma in the era.
